unitNotes.V-40: Quest-line, objectives, growth, run (3 h, tier 1, R-O-6; the slice): Engine.questLine(view, now) -> {steps: [{...step, state: 'done'|'current'|'locked', doneAt?}], current} from Content.questLine in order, each condition {event, count, within?} evaluated over the events (a step is done when its condition held and a QuestLineStepDone exists, current when its condition is the next to meet or met and unclaimed, locked after); Engine.unlocked(view) -> Set of feature ids = revealed(view) ∪ the reward. V-40 RULINGS (CORE 11, R-C-50): the Engine owns the swap replacement (items[].swapTo; Actions uses it); a day's draw reads only events dated before that day, so later events never change a past day; tests that later events never lower growth, best, total or unlocked; questLine().current.claimable is what Actions.questLine.claim trusts; unlocked = revealed + claimed rewards + FeatureUnlocked features, protected ids ignored; with no Content.questLine or Content.objectives each function returns its empty shape and never throws; SlipLogged, MilestoneSeen and the sober-day counters never count as a day shown up.
